road: drivable asphalt road surface in an urban street scene, flat ground for vehicles
sidewalk: pedestrian sidewalk or pavement next to the road, walkable area for people
building: building facade in an urban street scene, large static architectural structure
wall: vertical wall structure along the street, non-building barrier surface
fence: roadside fence or guard barrier with thin repeated bars or mesh pattern
pole: thin vertical pole, utility pole, or street lamp post
traffic light: small hanging or mounted traffic light signal at an intersection
traffic sign: roadside traffic sign board with symbol or text mounted on a pole
vegetation: trees, bushes, grass, and other green plants in outdoor street environment
terrain: natural ground such as soil, dirt, or slope beside the road, not paved
sky: open sky region above the scene, background atmosphere with clouds or clear sky
person: pedestrian person walking or standing on road or sidewalk
car: car, sedan, or passenger vehicle on the road
